source.description:
Hou Xiangting’s Journey of Love

Hou Xiangting appears in a close-up portrait, glancing over her shoulder with a warm smile. The softly blurred street scene behind her sets a casual, urban tone. Bold pink and yellow text reads “angel 爱之旅 journey of love,” framing the album’s theme of romance and optimism.

Released in 2001, Journey of Love features 17 tracks spanning 50 minutes. This Apple Music release showcases Hou Xiangting’s gentle vocal style and approachable image, inviting listeners into a heartfelt musical journey.

source.title: 昨天今天明天 - song and lyrics by 侯湘婷 | Spotify
source.description:
Album Cover for "昨天今天明天"

This cover art features Taiwanese singer 侯湘婷 standing in a lush, green outdoor setting. She wears a yellow top and holds a tree branch across her face, creating a sense of mystery and natural connection. The text "angel; 17,18,19; 侯湘婷" appears subtly in the lower right corner, indicating the album or single title.

Released in 2002, "昨天今天明天" is part of 侯湘婷’s discography and is available on Spotify. The minimalist design and earthy tones reflect the song’s introspective mood, while the artist’s name and album details are integrated into the artwork.

source.title: 侯湘婷 | Spotify
source.description:
侯湘婷 Album Cover

A serene album cover features Taiwanese singer 侯湘婷 in a close-up portrait set against rolling green hills. Her brown hair gently frames her face as she looks directly at the viewer with a calm expression. Overlaid white text reads “侯(湘婷) 你爱我吗? Do You Love Me?”, combining Chinese characters with an English subtitle.

This artwork serves as the cover image for 侯湘婷’s Spotify artist page, where she garners 45.1K monthly listeners. The natural outdoor setting and soft lighting create a peaceful, pastoral atmosphere that complements the album’s introspective title.

source.description:
Hou Xiang-ting’s 1999 Album Press Conference

Hou Xiang-ting, the Taiwanese singer and actress, attended her first Mandarin album press conference in 1999 wearing a traditional kimono. The photograph, taken by Chen Bo-lin for United Daily News, shows her smiling warmly in a softly lit room adorned with framed artwork. Her patterned kimono features cranes and waves, complemented by a bright pink obi, and her hair is styled in loose pigtails.

At just 17 years old, Hou Xiang-ting had already gained popularity through campus beauty contests and a hit telecommunications commercial. This event marked the launch of her debut album "Do You Love Me?"
